instruction: A candid documentary medium shot captures a joyful moment in a green garden. On the left, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) laughs heartily, looking toward the right. Beside her, the woman in the crocheted vest (R2) stands with her arms outstretched, reacting excitedly to an off-camera game. The background is filled with lush green bushes. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the scene, creating a warm and cheerful atmosphere with soft shadows. The two women share a lighthearted, interactive moment of celebration.
